country.match: Match each golfer to the country they represent.
country.odd: Three of these golfers represent {value}. Which one doesn't?

rows.label: Scottie Scheffler
rows.hook: rose to world number one and won the Masters more than once in the 2020s

rows.label: Rory McIlroy
rows.hook: won four major titles and is a fixture on Ryder Cup teams for Europe

rows.label: Shane Lowry
rows.hook: won a British major at Royal Portrush with a home crowd roaring him on

rows.label: Adam Scott
rows.hook: won the Masters in a playoff and is known for a famously elegant one-handed-finish swing

rows.label: Charley Hull
rows.hook: became a teenage star on the women's tour and a regular in Solheim Cup play

rows.label: John Daly
rows.hook: is a long-hitting, mullet-sporting champion who won two majors as a fan favorite

rows.label: Nelly Korda
rows.hook: is a women's world number one who won a major and an Olympic gold medal

rows.label: Bryson DeChambeau
rows.hook: is a physics-minded power hitter who won a major and later joined a breakaway tour

rows.label: Payne Stewart
rows.hook: was famous for wearing old-fashioned plus fours and a flat cap while winning major titles

rows.label: Arnold Palmer
rows.hook: was a charismatic star with a devoted fan army and a lemonade-and-iced-tea drink named for him

rows.label: Jack Nicklaus
rows.hook: won a record eighteen major championships and is nicknamed the Golden Bear

rows.label: Gary Player
rows.hook: was a pioneering international champion nicknamed the Black Knight who won the career Grand Slam

rows.label: Paige Spiranac
rows.hook: is a social media star who built a huge online following from golf trick shots and fashion

rows.label: Paul Casey
rows.hook: has been a mainstay of Europe's Ryder Cup teams and once climbed to third in the world rankings

rows.label: Phil Mickelson
rows.hook: is a left-hander who won a PGA Championship at age fifty, nicknamed Lefty

rows.label: Greg Norman
rows.hook: is a blond Hall of Famer nicknamed the Great White Shark, twice winner of the Open Championship

rows.label: Jon Rahm
rows.hook: won the Masters and a US Open and rose to world number one from a base in Basque country

rows.label: Collin Morikawa
rows.hook: won two major titles before turning thirty, including an Open Championship at Royal St George's

rows.label: Justin Rose
rows.hook: won the first Olympic gold medal in golf in over a century

rows.label: Bobby Jones
rows.hook: co-founded Augusta National and the Masters, and won all four major titles in a single season as an amateur

rows.label: Tommy Fleetwood
rows.hook: is a long-haired Ryder Cup favorite from the Southport area, famous for his flowing locks and beard

rows.label: Matthew Fitzpatrick
rows.hook: won the U.S. Open at Brookline after earlier winning the U.S. Amateur on the same course

rows.label: Brooks Koepka
rows.hook: is a powerful major specialist who has won multiple PGA Championships and US Opens

rows.label: Wyndham Clark
rows.hook: won the U.S. Open at Los Angeles Country Club for his first major title

rows.label: Jordan Spieth
rows.hook: won the Masters and the Open Championship as a young star and completed most of a career Grand Slam

rows.label: Seve Ballesteros
rows.hook: was a swashbuckling short-game wizard who inspired European golf and Ryder Cup success

rows.label: Francis Ouimet
rows.hook: stunned the sport as a local amateur who beat British stars to win the US Open, once caddied by a boy

rows.label: Ian Poulter
rows.hook: is known for flamboyant trousers and a fierce Ryder Cup record despite no major win

rows.label: Dustin Johnson
rows.hook: is a powerful, laid-back player who won two majors and became world number one

rows.label: Lee Trevino
rows.hook: was a wisecracking champion nicknamed the Merry Mex who won six majors and survived a lightning strike

rows.label: Patrick Reed
rows.hook: won the Masters and earned the nickname Captain America for his Ryder Cup play

rows.label: Ben Hogan
rows.hook: won majors after surviving a near-fatal car crash and wrote a famous book on swing fundamentals
